author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Require new GPS fixes after provider failure and fence recovery callbacks
details: Advance capture barriers before notifying consumers and after provider errors, preventing delayed pre-recovery fixes from restoring context. Record attributed earlier Apple builds without claiming current-head device or approved GPS transport acceptance.
validation: 15 portable Swift 6.0.3 Linux tests passed with complete strict concurrency and warnings as errors. Core Location/UIKit bodies excluded; contract, host integration and real-device gates remain.
